nodes.title: Sampler / Scheduler
widgets_values:
euler / res_multistep are the two main samplers.

Use Simple scheduler for most things. Beta produces bad audio quality. Normal seems to be good on euler.

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
REFERENCE ROLES

<Picture 1>
Use as the visual reference for the woman face, the bakery environment, lighting, materials, and overall photographic style.

<Video 1>
Use only as the camera-motion reference.
Follow the camera trajectory, timing, framing evolution, and parallax from this OmniCam 3D playblast.

CAMERA

Reproduce the camera behavior from <Video 1> as faithfully as possible:
camera translation and rotation, dolly, truck, pedestal, pan, tilt, orbit or crane motion when present, including acceleration, deceleration, timing, framing changes, and parallax evolution.

The generated shot must feel as if the real scene was filmed by the same camera move shown in <Video 1>.

Do not reproduce the proxy objects, low-poly geometry, materials, textures, colors, lighting, shading, background, or visual appearance of <Video 1>.
<Video 1> provides camera motion only.

SCENE

a epic fight scene between two medieval man 

LIGHTING & LOOK

Golden-hour sunlight enters the bakery.
Warm amber and orange tones, soft directional sunlight, subtle volumetric atmosphere, photorealistic materials and skin, cinematic shallow depth of field, natural contrast, sharp subject detail.

SHOT RULES

One continuous shot.
No cuts.
No camera discontinuities.
No sudden reframing.
Maintain spatial coherence throughout the camera movement.
Preserve the camera timing and trajectory from <Video 1>.

No text.
No logos.
No subtitles.
No broadcast graphics.

widgets_values:
OmniCam -> MiniMax H3 API  (profile: h3_api)

Base template: Comfy-Org/workflow_templates
  api_minimax_h3_r2v.json

WHAT CHANGED
Monitor.reference_video feeds Video 1. The API path takes a VIDEO directly,
where the native node wants decoded IMAGE frames - same playblast, two
transports, which is the whole reason h3_api and h3_native are separate
profiles rather than one with a switch.

THE PROMPT IS NOT WIRED
This node keeps its prompt as a widget, so copy Monitor.final_prompt into
it after the first queue. It already contains the camera-motion fragment
and the instruction to ignore the proxy's appearance. Refer to the
reference as 'Video 1' in any text you add.

HOW TO USE
1. Author the shot and click Playblast.
2. Queue once to compile. Read the preflight.
3. Copy final_prompt into the MiniMax node, then queue for real.

REFERENCE LIMITS
The API accepts 23.9-60.5 fps and a 2-15s reference. Preflight checks the
connected playblast against those and blocks outside them, so a reference
the service would reject never leaves your machine.

This is an API node: it needs Comfy API credits, not local weights.
